headline: Stanbic Bank Kenya 9M Net Profit Rises 10% to KES 10.3 Billion
summary: Stanbic Bank Kenya reported a 10% increase in nine-month net profit to 10.32 billion Kenyan shillings, supported by higher interest income.
why: Stanbic Bank Kenya is a major financial services provider operating in East Africa, listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange.
